annotation.fine_grained_rationale: Practical instruction about recording gameplay and monetizing gaming content is central; the speaker also qualifies the income available from YouTube ads.

evidence.observation: The speaker frames the video around earning money from gaming.
evidence.quote: how do I earn money playing video games

evidence.observation: The speaker relays advice to record gameplay for material worth showing.
evidence.quote: you need to record your entire day of gaming and do it every day, is because you never know when you are going to do something unique that you want to show.

evidence.observation: The speaker says earning a living from gaming requires time.
evidence.quote: If you want to play video games for a living, you have to put in the time

evidence.observation: The speaker quotes a commission offer tied to sales through an affiliate link.
evidence.quote: you will receive ten percent commission for each sale from your affiliate link

evidence.observation: The speaker describes a priced FIFA course as an example of selling gaming instruction.
evidence.quote: This was the new one FIFA 19 from zero to hero 33 minutes long 18 lectures. There's been four Ratings okay, and it sold for normally $19.99, and today it's selling for $9.99.

evidence.observation: The speaker qualifies the earning potential of gaming videos supported by YouTube ads.
evidence.quote: video games are not going to make you rich if you are using youtube ads

evidence.observation: The description promotes a separate affiliate-marketing course, without stating a price.
evidence.quote: Affiliate Marketing Monster's - Full Course :check mark button: Affiliate Marketing Monster's will teach you how to do affiliate marketing even if you are a beginner.

evidence.observation: The speaker identifies an affiliate link while examining another person's gaming video.
evidence.quote: you can see there's his affiliate link

evidence.observation: The speaker describes a price for in-game coins, not an investment contribution or guidance fee.
evidence.quote: you could buy your a million coins right here for Xbox 1 and cost you 109 dollars
